text: The Patriots cruised past the Steelers 20-3 in their Week 2 home opener at Gillette Stadium, with TreVeyon Henderson scoring a touchdown as the defense carried the load while the offense continued searching for the rhythm that fueled last season's Super Bowl run. The victory marked a historic milestone, making the Patriots the first of the original AFL teams to reach 600 wins, though the celebration was tempered by injuries sustained in the win—most notably starting right guard Mike Onwenu, whose initial X-rays revealed a broken right ankle that will force New England to shuffle its offensive line. Head Coach Mike Vrabel and his squad found a way to overcome what appears to be an early-season personnel setback, demonstrating that this team's defensive prowess remains a legitimate calling card even as the offensive units work to find their footing heading forward.
